_comment: Service-mix calibration derived from a real Google Cloud billing export (one monthly invoice). Contains ONLY non-sensitive GCP service names and their normalized cost proportions -- no account IDs, project names, dollar amounts, SKUs, or dates. Used to shape the synthetic benchmark so its structure (a dominant always-on database plus smaller deploy/traffic-driven services) reflects a real bill rather than invented proportions. Seasonality and anomalies are still injected synthetically with known ground truth.
source: Real GCP billing export, single monthly invoice, aggregated to service level and normalized.

steady_services._note: Always-on infrastructure: no weekday/weekend cycle, low day-to-day noise.

variable_services._note: Deploy / traffic driven: weekday spend exceeds weekend, higher noise.
